title: SHO destroys Roppongi 3K
summary: A losing run fractures SHO and YOH’s partnership. SHO abandons his long-time teammate and chooses a darker alliance rather than rebuilding their tag team.

chapters.title: SHO abandons YOH
chapters.result: SHO turns against YOH during the junior tag league.
chapters.context: Frustration becomes an attack on his own partner, ending the familiar Roppongi 3K pairing.

chapters.title: SHO wins and joins House of Torture
chapters.show: Wrestle Grand Slam in MetLife Dome — Night 1
chapters.result: SHO defeats YOH and aligns with House of Torture.
chapters.context: The singles victory confirms that his new identity is built around rejecting his former partner and embracing outside assistance.
